# Tempo variables

`tempo.json` contains the resolved variable data from `tempoxyz/tempo.xyz` at commit `848a9cddc41656b0626b581f931618bfa2cbfe68`:

https://github.com/tempoxyz/tempo.xyz/blob/848a9cddc41656b0626b581f931618bfa2cbfe68/src/zyzz.config.ts

The literal `Vars.define` input and its typography references were extracted without executing the application. Responsive values and `mappings: false` are preserved. Font files and global styles are excluded.
